captions.ig:
Most people pay for at least one subscription they forgot. Here is how to find and stop them.

1. Download 3 months of statements from your bank, every card and PayPal.
2. Check your app stores. iPhone: Settings, tap your name, Subscriptions. Android: Play Store, profile icon, Payments and subscriptions, Subscriptions.
3. Black out card numbers, upload the statements to Claude and ask it to find every recurring charge, renewal and trial that turned paid, with the yearly cost of each.
4. Cancel where you signed up and screenshot the confirmation. A new card does not stop it: Visa can send your new number to the company.
5. Still charged? For bank debits, tell your bank to stop the payment at least 3 business days before it is due. On a credit card, dispute in writing within 60 days of the statement.

Comment SUBS and we will DM you our free subscription guide: the Claude prompts to find every recurring charge, and how to cancel the right way.

Calendar numbers are a sample. General info, not financial advice. Sources: Apple, iGeeksBlog, TechRadar, SlashGear, Visa, Quartz, CFPB, California AG, Experian.
